• Type: Rosulate
  • Origin: Cultivar
  • Growth rate: Medium
  • Height: 20 - 30+ cm
  • Light demand: Low
  • CO2: Low
A nutritious bottom promotes growth, but otherwise Echinodorus 'Rosé' is undemanding and thus an excellent plant for beginners.

This beautiful plant is a hybrid between Echinodorus horemanii 'Red' and Echinodorus horizontalis. It was first produced in 1986 by Hans Barth in Dessau and becomes 25-40 cm tall and a rosette 15-25 cm wide. New underwater leaves are a beautiful pink, and initially the leaves have red-brown spots.

Sold as a large mother plant, grown in a 9 cm square pot.
